title: Sigurnosna arhitektura
summary: Sigurnosne implikacije arhitekturnih modela (cloud, serverless, IaC, OT, air-gap, mikroservisi) i upravljanje arhitekturom: zone, Zero Trust, siguran udaljeni pristup, SSE, servisni nalozi i failure modes.
summary_en: Security implications of architecture models (cloud, serverless, IaC, OT, air-gap, microservices) and architecture management: zones, Zero Trust, secure remote access, SSE, service accounts, and failure modes.
